name: Kobayashi Reika
source:
She is the sister of the main character.  She loves him very much and even thinks that “Japanese laws should be revised so that she can marry her brother.

She is also the homeroom teacher of the class, and is the most powerful person in the school. She is extremely preferential to the main character, but when she gets angry, she is so frightening that no one can complain.
